lines.en: Hello. Please take us to the art museum.
Sure. Please sit in the back seat.
Thank you. Do you usually drive in this city?
Yes. I started driving a taxi twenty years ago.
lines.ko: 네. 이십 년 전에 택시 운전을 시작했어요.

lines.en: Wow. Is the museum far?
No. We will arrive in ten minutes.
lines.ko: 아니요. 십 분 후에 도착할 거예요.

lines.en: Good. I will meet my friend there.
This taxi has a new engine. The ride is smooth.
lines.ko: 이 택시는 엔진이 새것이에요. 승차감이 부드러워요.

lines.en: It's very quiet. Can you stop at the front gate?
lines.ko: 아주 조용하네요. 정문 앞에서 세워 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Have a nice day, Ma'am.
Excuse me. Where is the parking lot?
It's behind the building. Follow the sign.
Thank you. I don't drive often.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 저는 운전을 자주 안 해요.

lines.en: No problem. Is your car big or small?
It's small. My son gave it to me last year.
Nice. Turn the wheel slowly to the left.
Like this? Is the space enough?
Yes, very good. Please turn off the engine.
Thanks. I will buy gas later.
The gas station is across the street.
